df4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_30/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all source tables
df_union = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3, df4], ignore_index=True)

# Group by 'categories' and 'id' to remove duplicates and aggregate other columns by max
agg_columns = [
    'commentCount', 'completed', 'copyright', 'cover', 'cover_timestamp', 'createDate', 'deleted',
    'description', 'firstPartId', 'firstPublishedPart.createDate', 'firstPublishedPart.id',
    'language.id', 'language.name', 'lastPublishedPart.createDate', 'lastPublishedPart.id',
    'length', 'mature', 'modifyDate', 'numParts', 'parts', 'rating', 'readCount', 'tags',
    'title', 'url', 'user.avatar', 'user.fullname', 'user.name', 'voteCount'
]

# For boolean columns, max works as logical OR, which is acceptable here.
# For string columns, max picks lexicographically max string, which is acceptable to pick one consistent value.

df_final = df_union.groupby(['categories', 'id'], as_index=False).agg({col: 'max' for col in agg_columns})

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = ['categories', 'commentCount', 'completed', 'copyright', 'cover', 'cover_timestamp',
                  'createDate', 'deleted', 'description', 'firstPartId', 'firstPublishedPart.createDate',
                  'firstPublishedPart.id', 'id', 'language.id', 'language.name', 'lastPublishedPart.createDate',
                  'lastPublishedPart.id', 'length', 'mature', 'modifyDate', 'numParts', 'parts', 'rating',
                  'readCount', 'tags', 'title', 'url', 'user.avatar', 'user.fullname', 'user.name', 'voteCount']

# 'categories' and 'id' are already in df_final, but 'id' is after 'firstPublishedPart.id' in target schema,

# Move 'id' column to the correct position (13th index, zero-based)
cols = df_final.columns.tolist()

cols.insert(12, 'id')  # Insert 'id' at position 12 (0-based)

# Ensure columns order matches target_columns
df_final = df_final[cols]

# Save to target CSV
